objective: Produce a high-context technical book report whose argument remains understandable without relying on keyword emphasis or framework familiarity.

phases.action: State what the reader should understand or decide, prior knowledge, non-scope and source limits.
holdWhen: the report is only a directory tour

phases.action: Model the topic with high-level concepts such as state ownership, time, control, effect and durability before naming project mechanisms.
holdWhen: the outline is a list of technologies
chapter order follows folders instead of reader causality

phases.action: Bind each material claim to observed source fact, external background or project inference and retain limitations.
holdWhen: a material claim has no source or inference disposition
external background is presented as project observation

phases.action: Write each section as reader question, context, thesis, causal explanation, worked trace, failure path, limitation and transition.
holdWhen: headings or bullets carry the argument

phases.action: Choose Monograph for explanatory progress and Notebook for evidence review, then map only argument-supporting diagrams and notes.
Render frozen HTML/CSS into selectable-text A4 PDF and page previews.
Apply the editorial rubric and contact-sheet review without claiming independence or acceptance.
Validate frozen facts and visual expression without mutation.
exitEvidence: independent validation report or explicit pending disposition
holdWhen: recipient acknowledgement is absent when required

revisionTriggers: page mode does not match content function
stopConditions: a material claim cannot be separated from unsupported inference
the same keyword-led structure fails twice without a changed conceptual model
a decision belongs to an external acceptance or publication owner
